sets.q: A baker made 360 rolls. She sold 185 rolls. How many rolls does she have left? Add or subtract? Type add or subtract.
sets.why: The clue words ask what is left or the gap, so you subtract.
sets.no: Find the clue word first. Does it ask for a total, or for what is left or the gap?

sets.q: Kim walked 245 steps to the park and 318 steps to the store. How many steps did she walk in all? Add or subtract? Type add or subtract.
sets.why: The clue words ask for the total, so you add.
sets.no: Find the clue word first. Does it ask for a total, or for what is left or the gap?

sets.q: Round 716 to the nearest hundred: ____
sets.why: Look at the tens digit: 1. Less than 5 rounds down. So 716 rounds to 700.
sets.no: Look at the tens digit. 5 or more rounds up. Less than 5 rounds down.
sets.hint: 716 is between 700 and 800. Which is it closer to?

sets.q: Round each number to the nearest hundred. Then add. Estimate 184 + 523: ____
sets.no: Round first: 184 → ?, 523 → ?. Then add the round numbers.

sets.q: Round each number to the nearest hundred. Then subtract. Estimate 791 − 312: ____
sets.no: Round first: 791 → ?, 312 → ?. Then subtract the round numbers.

sets.q: A parade had 268 kids and 175 adults. How many people altogether?
sets.why: The clue word means add. 268 + 175 = 443 people.
sets.no: Add 268 + 175. Line up the ones. Regroup when a column makes 10 or more.

sets.q: A tank holds 600 gallons. It has 374 gallons now. How many more gallons will fill it?
sets.why: The clue word means subtract. 600 − 374 = 226 gallons.
sets.no: Subtract 600 − 374. Start with the ones. Borrow when the top digit is too small.

sets.q: Estimate first: 267 + 445 is about 300 + 400 = 700. Which answer is reasonable?
sets.why: 267 + 445 = 712. It is close to the estimate, 700.
no: 178 is what you get if you subtract. This problem adds.
7,120 is about ten times too big. It is not close to 700.

sets.q: Which question tells you to subtract?
choices: How many cookies did they bake altogether?
sets.why: Remain means what is still there. Subtract.

sets.q: Read Ben's Puppy. What is the theme?
choices: One morning, Ben forgot to feed the puppy, and it whined.
Keep your promises, even when it is hard.
sets.why: Ben broke his promise and felt awful. Then he kept it. That is the theme.
no: That is plot. It tells what happens.
That is not the lesson of the story.
A theme is a whole idea, not one name.

visual.text: Ben begged for a puppy. Mom said, “You must feed him every morning.” Ben promised. One morning, Ben forgot. The puppy whined at his empty bowl. Ben felt awful. After that, Ben set an alarm and never forgot again.

sets.q: “Keeping a promise shows you care.” Is this the plot or the theme? Type plot or theme.
sets.why: It is a lesson about life, so it is a theme.
sets.no: Plot is what happens. Theme is a lesson about life.

sets.q: An answer that makes sense and is close to the estimate is ________.
sets.why: It is reasonable.
sets.no: It is one of today's math words.

sets.q: A fair sold 189 lemonades and 236 snow cones. What is the total?
sets.why: The clue word means add. 189 + 236 = 425 lemonades and snow cones.
sets.no: Add 189 + 236. Line up the ones. Regroup when a column makes 10 or more.

sets.q: Malik had 520 stickers. He gave away 193. How many stickers are left?
sets.why: The clue word means subtract. 520 − 193 = 327 stickers.
sets.no: Subtract 520 − 193. Start with the ones. Borrow when the top digit is too small.

sets.q: Estimate first: 644 − 287 is about 600 − 300 = 300. Which answer is reasonable?
sets.why: 644 − 287 = 357. It is close to the estimate, 300.
no: 931 is what you get if you add. This problem subtracts, so the answer must be smaller than 644.
3,570 is about ten times too big. It is not close to 300.

sets.q: “Ava has 342 stickers. Leo has 276. How many more does Ava have?” What do you do?
sets.why: How many more asks for the gap. Take the smaller number from the bigger one: 342 − 276.
no: “More” tricks people. It asks for the gap, so subtract.

sets.q: Read Grace and the Race. What is the theme?
choices: Treat others the way you want to be treated.
On race day, Grace tripped and fell, and Tom helped her up.
sets.why: Grace laughed at Tom, but Tom was kind to her. That is the theme.
no: That is plot. It tells what happens.
That is not the lesson of the story.
A theme is a whole idea, not one name.

visual.text: Grace laughed at Tom because he ran slowly. On race day, Grace tripped and fell. Tom stopped running and helped her up. Grace's face turned red. “I'm sorry I laughed at you,” she said.

sets.q: “Tom helped Grace get up.” Is this the plot or the theme? Type plot or theme.
sets.why: It tells what happens, so it is plot.
sets.no: Plot is what happens. Theme is a lesson about life.

sets.q: The lesson about life that a story teaches is the ________.
sets.why: It is the theme.
sets.no: It is today's big reading word.
